plot: On a sunny beach morning Bird keeps swooping off with Max's ball, star and snack box, so Max calls her a thief; his one big jump to catch her ends face-first in the sand, so he follows her up the sand hill, finds his things lined up safe and dry, and from the top sees the sea has crept up over his towel: Bird was rescuing his things from the rising tide all along, and Max says sorry for not asking first.

beats.say: Hey! Bird! Come back here with my red ball!
Whoosh! Bird swoops down and flies off with Max's ball!
Why is Bird taking my things? Is Bird a beach thief?
It is a bright, sunny morning at the beach. Swish, swish.
Woof! Max, why are you yelling at the sky?
Bird grabbed my red ball and just flew away with it!
Maybe Bird wants to play fetch. I love fetch!
Bird never plays fetch, Dog. Bird only plays chatter-chatter.
A tiny wave rolls up the sand and tickles Max's toes.
Eek! Cold, cold, cold! Silly wave. Go back home!
Max! Max! The sea is creeping up! Creep, creep, creep!
Never mind the sea, Bird. Where is my red ball?
No time to talk! Busy, busy, busy! Bye!
Swoop! Now Bird grabs Max's gold star and zooms off again!
My shiny star too! Bird is taking everything I love!
Max, what happened? You look like a sad wet sock.
Bird took my ball. Then Bird took my star. One, two!
Bird is very chatty, but she is never naughty. Strange.
Maybe Bird is building a nest. A big shiny nest!
A nest made of my toys? Then I will catch her!
Snack box, you stay right here. Nobody takes my lunch.
Max hides behind his blue snack box. He waits, and waits.
Max, my paws are all wet now. Is the beach shrinking?
Shh, Dog! I'm catching a thief. Beaches don't shrink.
If Bird takes the snack box, we will have no lunch!
Then this is my last chance. I must catch her now!
Here comes Bird! She grabs the snack box with her feet!
Gotcha now, Bird! One, two, three... JUMP!
Max jumps high... and lands face first in the sand. Flump!
Pfft! Sand in my nose. Sand in my whiskers. Sand everywhere!
Ha! You look like a sugar donut, Max!
Look! Bird is flying to the top of the big sand hill.
No more jumping. I will follow her and find her secret.
I'm coming too! My legs are short, but my eyes are sharp.
Max, Mouse and Dog climb up, up, up the sand hill.
Puff, puff. This hill is taller than my dinner bowl!
At the top, they find... the red ball and the gold star!
My ball! My star! And they're lined up in a neat row?
And my snack box is here too, tucked in gently.
A thief doesn't line things up so nicely. What is going on?
And everything is dry. Warm and dry, like a cozy bed.
Oh no, you found my spot! Wait here! One more thing!
Bird zips back down the hill, fast as a sneeze.
One more thing? But there's nothing left down there!
There is! My banana lunch is still on my towel!
Why does Bird want a banana? Bird doesn't even like bananas!
If Bird isn't a thief, then what is she doing?
I have to see. Let me look down from the top.
Max looks down at the spot where his towel was...
...and his towel is gone. Now there is only blue sea!
The sea came up the beach! Bird told us! Creep, creep!
That's why Dog's paws were wet! The beach got smaller!
I said the beach was shrinking! Woof! I was right!
Bird wasn't stealing. She was saving my things from the waves!
Up flies Bird, holding one yellow banana in her feet.
Got it! Phew! The banana almost went swimming!
Bird, I'm sorry. I called you a thief. You're a hero!
I tried to tell you, Max! But you were too busy chasing.
Next time I'll stop and ask before I chase.
And next time, we listen when Bird says creep, creep!
So they have a picnic on the dry, warm sand hill.
Can I go down and play with the waves now? Please?
Splash! Dog runs into the waves. The waves splash right back!
Woof! The sea plays fetch with me! Best friend ever!
See? The sea is not a thief either. It just moves!
Before you say someone is bad, ask them why.
Tomorrow, let's find out where the sea goes at night!
